messages:
Kai (People Ops): Heads up 12 I'm publishing a short manager cheat-sheet + templates for review forms to handle LOA, mid-cycle hires, contractor conversions, and PIP flags. Wanted quick feedback before send.
Ruth (Eng Manager): Love the idea. Can we have 2-3 ready-made one-line templates managers can paste? That reduces variance.
Omar (Product Manager): Also need clarity on when managers should leave "insufficient data" vs giving a provisional rating. Last cycle folks got mixed signals.
Dev (HRBP): Operational guidance proposal: 1) If >30% LOA -> select "Partial data (LOA)"; 2) If tenure <90d -> select "New hire <90d"; 3) Contractor->FTE -> record conversion date; 4) PIP during cycle -> check hidden flag for calibration. Provisional ratings allowed but must be flagged.
Kai (People Ops): Ok I'll add those rules to the cheat-sheet and the form. For the templates I'm drafting: (A) LOA: "On parental leave 6/10-8/12; observed contributions before/after leave; provisional rating flagged for calibration." (B) New hire: "Joined 7/15; ramping on product discovery; insufficient data for a full-cycle rating; recommends ramp goals." (C) Conversion: "Converted from contractor on 9/2; prior work project-based; recommend discussing pre/post conversion context in calibration." Are those helpful?
Ruth (Eng Manager): Perfect. Can we also add a short recommended evidence list: 1-3 artifacts (PRs, dashboards, decks) and a link field. That sped things up for me.
Omar (Product Manager): For "insufficient data" my ask: make it show in the packet with a note and require a 1-line rationale. Calibration should decide on deferral vs provisional.
Dev (HRBP): Agreed. We'll ensure "Insufficient data" entries appear in the packet with their justification and a quick "Recommend" field for calibration chairs. Also add a Helpdesk link for extension requests.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: review forms due EOD Fri. Forms + templates: https://docs.internal/redwood/reviews/forms. Request extension: https://helpdesk.internal/redwood/review-exceptions :bell: 
Kai (People Ops): Final UX pieces: dropdown for category, required 1-line rationale, evidence links (0-5), hidden PIP flag, auto-fill LOA/convert dates from HRIS (editable), and a "Flag for calibration" checkbox auto-checked for Partial data & Conversion by default. Managers can uncheck with a confirmation.
Ruth (Eng Manager): One more UX ask: auto-populate conversion/LOA dates where HRIS has them so we don't miss things. But require manager confirmation before submit.
Kai (People Ops): Yup prefilling + confirmation checkbox is in the plan. Last ops note: if you have >3 flagged provisional ratings, request an expanded calibration slot here: https://calendly.internal/redwood/calibration-requests. I'll publish the cheat-sheet + examples in 20m and mail managers. DM me if you want a 5-min walkthrough. :thumbsup:
